name: Forcas Studio Ltd
about: Incorporated in April 2010, Forcas Studio Limited sells men's clothing, including shirts, jeans, t-shirts, trousers, cotton pants, sportswear, party wear, fashion wear, and boxers.[1]
keyPoints: Product Portfolio[1] Company offers a wide range of products, including shirts, denim, t-shirts, trousers, cotton pants, sportswear, party wear, fashion wear, and boxers for the Indian menswear segment.
